regions.name: Amazon North
visual_identifiers: red or orange dirt roads common

state_distinguishers.Amazonas_vs_Para: Amazonas more remote jungle. Para has more deforestation frontier visible. Belem urban area in Para.

regions.route_sign_clues: BR federal routes. State routes use AM (Amazonas), PA (Para) prefix.
regions.gemini_hint: Dense tropical canopy with red dirt road = Amazon region almost certainly. River visible = likely Para or Amazonas.

regions.name: Northeast

state_distinguishers.Bahia_vs_Ceara: Bahia larger and more varied. Ceara more consistently arid. Salvador coastal area distinctive.
state_distinguishers.Pernambuco_coastal: Recife urban area very distinctive with bridges and rivers.

regions.route_sign_clues: BA (Bahia), CE (Ceara), PE (Pernambuco) state route prefixes.
regions.gemini_hint: Dry thorny caatinga scrub with red soil = Northeast Brazil. Pastel colored small town = likely northeastern interior.

regions.name: Southeast
visual_identifiers: dense urban sprawl around Sao Paulo
specific Rio de Janeiro dramatic topography

state_distinguishers.Sao_Paulo_vs_Minas: Sao Paulo more industrial and flat. Minas has more colonial towns and mining landscape.
state_distinguishers.Rio_de_Janeiro: Distinctive mountains meeting ocean. Favela architecture on hillsides.

regions.route_sign_clues: SP (Sao Paulo), RJ (Rio), MG (Minas Gerais) prefixes.
regions.gemini_hint: Mountains dramatically meeting coast = Rio de Janeiro almost certainly. Dense industrial highway = likely Sao Paulo state.

regions.name: South
visual_identifiers: looks significantly different from rest of Brazil
wine country in Rio Grande do Sul

state_distinguishers.Rio_Grande_do_Sul_vs_Santa_Catarina: RS more gaucho/pampas feel in south, Germanic towns in north. SC more varied coastal and mountain.
state_distinguishers.Parana_vs_Santa_Catarina: Parana has Iguazu Falls area. Both have Araucaria pines.

regions.route_sign_clues: RS, SC, PR prefixes on state routes.
regions.gemini_hint: Araucaria pine trees (flat-topped umbrella shaped) = Southern Brazil almost certainly. European style architecture = Rio Grande do Sul or Santa Catarina.

regions.name: Cerrado Central

state_distinguishers.Goias_vs_Mato_Grosso: Goias more developed near Brasilia. Mato Grosso more frontier agricultural.
state_distinguishers.Distrito_Federal: Brasilia distinctive modernist architecture and very specific urban planning.

regions.route_sign_clues: GO, MT, MS prefixes. Brasilia has distinctive road naming system.
regions.gemini_hint: Twisted cerrado trees with red clay soil = Central Brazil cerrado. Modernist architecture = Brasilia/DF.
